description: We are a team of 8-9 year olds, who are passionate about space and game design.
summary: This is a game where you are on the moon, you are the only one and you have to survive. The red arrow will direct you to the electrolysis and when you click it, it will start making oxygen for you. It will take other resources from you though. Then, the arrow will disappear. After that, you have to go to the bottom right corner of the place you are in. Then, you click on the rock and carry it to the furnace to make oxygen
details: This game is a lunar survival simulator, where you have to survive for as long as possible  on the moon. It inspires young people to get more into space exploration. In this project we used scratch and pixel art drawing.  The textures of the game are made of pixels. The moon base is equipped  with solar panels, an electrolysis machine, a rock furnace, and a vertical farm. We had to choose between pixel art and other types of art style also. Some of the design choices we made were to only focus on the immediate resources to keep us alive. We also decided to make electricity an unupgradable resource to limit how many machines we could use.
